sandbachFocus: Sandbach United host Alsager Town on Saturday at 15:00, looking to bounce back from their most recent loss. Despite that recent setback, Sandbach remain top of the table with 22 points from 10 games, and they will be heavy favorites against Alsager Town, who sit bottom of the division with just 4 points from 10 matches and are in poor form with one win in their last five.
divisionWide: Second-placed Stafford Town face a trip to Dawley Town on Saturday as they chase Sandbach's lead, having won their most recent outing. Third-ranked AFC Bridgnorth host Eccleshall in a fixture between two of the division's stronger sides, with both teams capable of climbing the table. Wolverhampton Casuals, fourth and in good recent form, travel to Wednesfield Community (who have won their last two), then face Brereton Social at home on Wednesday evening in an intriguing midweek clash. Bilston Town, sitting sixth, host Foley Meir on Saturday. Barnton welcome Shawbury United, with Barnton looking to maintain their recent winning run against a side struggling badly at the foot of the form table with six consecutive losses. New Mills travel to Market Drayton Town in a match between mid-table sides. Cheadle Heath Nomads visit Telford Town in a basement battle, with both teams among the division's poorest performers. Widnes Town, pointless from seven games and on a five-game losing streak, travel to Brereton Social on Saturday. Crewe host Allscott Heath in a fixture between sides in the bottom half of the division.
